title: Berry Delight Smoothie
description: A delicious and refreshing smoothie made with frozen delight and mixed berries. Perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Taste and adjust sweetness as needed.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional berries, if desired.
Serve chilled or over ice for a thicker consistency.
Store leftover smoothie in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Blend again before serving, if desired.
Consider adding a handful of spinach or kale for a green smoothie twist.
Experiment with different types of non-dairy milk and sweeteners to find your favorite combination.
